question: Adobe MTS-1 off-campus technical interview, round 2. **Explain compile-time versus run-time polymorphism**, with **real-world examples and code**, and the interviewer let the candidate choose any IDE to write it.
lookingFor: Clear definition and the real difference (binding time).
Understanding of how dynamic dispatch works (vtable).
Ability to relate to real-world analogies and write correct code.
Awareness of limits: what does not dispatch dynamically.
followUps: Can static methods be overridden? What happens instead?
How is run-time polymorphism implemented internally?
What is the difference between overloading and overriding?
Does polymorphism work for fields? Why or why not?
